title: Samsung bans smart TV apps that share users’ internet connections with strangers
summary: Several popular Samsung smart TV apps contain code that share the owner’s internet connection with strangers, potentially putting millions of Samsung smart TVs at risk of hijacking, according to new security research published on Monday.
